app_editor_source.note: app-editor.html — the app's real editor.html + editor-main.ts, only the Tauri seams mocked; the docs demo's "editor" surface frames this instead of a hand-assembled mock. Accepts ?lang=en|zh-hant|zh-hans to render its own UI strings AND to pick which in-memory project opens: a William Blake project for en, a 朱耷 project (traditional characters for zh-hant, simplified for zh-hans) otherwise. Backed by a real in-memory project, so creating a page, Save as Template…, New from template, Manage Templates, and versions mode (list/diff/restore OF THE OPEN PIECE) all really work — not just the tree/chip/divider interactions a prior harvest supported. Context-menu rows and the ＋▾ create/template menus carry a stable `data-action` attribute (their own i18n key, or `template:<id>` / `manage-template:<id>` for a saved template's own rows). Breadcrumb is flush left; double-clicking the tree's bottom border (#divider) collapses/reopens the tree (a height change on #nav-surface, rows stay mounted).
